anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: From the lambs and from the kids.

choices.why: Hedge: perhaps the majority take him as kid.

pass_a_gloss: And those chewing do not chew similarly but differently each according to his own power, not all being able to partake of him as of a sheep, but some and perhaps more as of a kid.
pass_b_english: [And those who chew do not chew in the same way, but each differently according to his own power — not all being able to partake of him as of a sheep, but some, and perhaps more, as of a kid.]
source_text: [Καὶ οἱ τρώγοντες δὲ οὐχ ὁμοίως τρώγουσιν ἀλλὰ διαφόρως ἕκαστος κατὰ τὴν ἰδίαν δύναμιν, οὐ πάντων ὡς προβάτου δυναμένων μεταλαμβάνειν αὐτοῦ, ἀλλά τινων καὶ τάχα πλειόνων ὡς ἐρίφου.
